query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) THEN 'Week 1 (This week)'
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 WEEK) THEN 'Week 2 (Last week)'
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 WEEK) THEN 'Week 3'
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) THEN 'Week 4'
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 WEEK) THEN 'Week 5'
    WHEN createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 WEEK) THEN 'Week 6'
  END as week_label,
  MIN(DATE(createdAt)) as week_start,
  MAX(DATE(createdAt)) as week_end,
  COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT visitorFingerprint) as unique_visitors,
  SUM(totalPageViews) as total_pageviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chatbotEngaged = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as chatbot_engagements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN convertedToLead = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as leads_converted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN isHighIntent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_intent_visitors,
  ROUND(AVG(timeOnSite)/60, 1) as avg_time_on_site_mins
FROM visitor_tracking
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 WEEK)
GROUP BY week_label
ORDER BY week_start DESC;
